translations.text: Almighty Father up in the heavens, you who created and made the bright creation and established the whole expanse of the earth: I acknowledge you as the one eternal God, and gladly believe in you.
You are the Lord of life, the origin of the angels, the ruler of the earth. You made the depths of the ocean, and you know the multitude of the glorious stars.
I believe in your true Son, the saving King, sent here from the heavenly kingdom of the angels, whom Gabriel, God's messenger, announced to Saint Mary herself.
A spotless woman, she freely received that message, and beneath her breast she bore a child for you, the Father himself.
No sin was committed there in the giving, but there the Holy Spirit gave a gift with his own hand and filled the maiden's womb with bliss,
and she openly bore the glorious Creator of angels for the dwellers on earth. He became a comfort to the people of the earth, and around Bethlehem angels proclaimed that Christ was born on earth.
When Pontius Pilate ruled the kingdom and its courts under the Romans, the precious Lord suffered death and climbed onto the cross,
the Lord of men, whom Joseph buried with a sad heart. And as plunder he fetched many souls out of hell, out of that house of torment, and commanded them to seek the heavenly homeland.
Then on the third day the ruler of nations, the lord of the kingdom, quickly rose from the earth, and for forty days he taught his followers secret counsels,
and when he began to seek his kingdom, the heavenly homeland, he said that he would not forsake anyone who would follow him from then on and keep faith with him in love with a steadfast mind.
I hold the Holy Spirit fast in hope, just as eternal as either the Father or the noble Son is said to be in the languages of the peoples.

These are not three gods, though named three times, but there is one God, who has all three names in the mysteries of things: true and victorious over the wide creation, giver of glory to the hosts, splendid and eternal.
I also believe that those who with one mind praise the Lord, the high King of the heavens, here in this life, are dear to God,
and I trust in the glorious communion of your saints here in this life.
I believe in the forgiveness of every sin,
and I trust in the resurrection of all flesh on earth at that fearful time,
when you will give eternal life to all, according to how each person here pleases the Lord.
